ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black) pixel base with high-intensity (white) linear disruptions; estimated ratio of 80:20 low-to-high intensity across visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Concentrated high-intensity white linear streaks forming dense clusters on the medial-to-distal region of the right lobe; sparse white mottling and singular spots located along the leading edges and distal tips of both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Approximately 40-50 degree V-shaped depression; central vertex is partially occluded by water spray but suggests a deep, narrow convergence.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations along the entire trailing boundary with pixel amplitudes ranging from 3 to 12 pixels; notable jagged indentation on the distal third of the right lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex leading edges curving posteriorly toward acute distal tips; trailing edge lobes exhibit a complex posterior-facing convexity with localized irregularities.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Small, high-contrast circular pixel clusters (approx. 2-6 pixels in diameter) scattered near the trailing edge and notch region, likely representing barnacle attachment sites.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Extensive network of distinct, unaligned, and parallel high-intensity linear scratches (rake marks) predominantly covering the right lobe and the medial section of the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Dense, overlapping rake mark scarring across both lobes, with a significantly higher density of intersecting marks on the right lobe relative to the left; minor irregular chip/notch on the right trailing edge.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique 'grid-like' overlapping pattern of linear abrasions located centrally on the right lobe.
